title: AtlasEvidenceRecord
description: Links one important claim to its provenance. Provenance over duplication: evidence records reference sources instead of copying long external content. Specification version 0.1.0.

schema_version.description: Specification version of this record (0.x during initial development).

claim_type.description: What kind of claim this evidence supports.

field_path.description: Dotted path of the claim inside the target record, e.g. 'vram.measured_vram_gib'.

source_id.description: Reference to a record conforming to source.schema.json.

source_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Relative strings and bare text are rejected by the pattern constraint.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 retrieval timestamp with timezone. Links to main/master branches are not immutable revisions.

evidence_level.description: Publisher, quantizer, and community statements stay distinct from independent and Atlas measurements.
